changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla topic_prerequisites: aristas del DAG de prerrequisitos, con el origen de la arista. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría topic_prerequisites_audit y el trigger topic_prerequisites_audit_trg.

column.name: prerequisite_topic_id
column.remarks: Topic that must be mastered first

column.name: origin
column.remarks: Who created the edge: llm or instructor

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE topic_prerequisites ADD CONSTRAINT topic_prerequisites_not_self_ck CHECK (topic_id <> prerequisite_topic_id)
ALTER TABLE topic_prerequisites ADD CONSTRAINT topic_prerequisites_origin_ck CHECK (origin IN ('llm', 'instructor'))
CREATE TRIGGER topic_prerequisites_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON topic_prerequisites FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in topic_prerequisites

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE topic_prerequisites_audit ADD CONSTRAINT topic_prerequisites_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER topic_prerequisites_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON topic_prerequisites FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS topic_prerequisites_audit_trg ON topic_prerequisites
